findings.title: Historical non-parallel compilation test fixture

findings.title: Pre-observation candidate expectation contract
findings.requiredFollowUp: Use freeze/verify and preserve the pre-registered case manifest when later scopes observe or minimize candidates.
findings.resolution: Four cases were frozen before focused parser replay with valid seeds, exact mutations, independent classifications, root-cause/context fingerprints, raw source hashes and minimization preservation rules. Contract tests reject invalid seeds, post-hoc expected-diagnostic replacement, identifier-only duplicate coverage, source drift, observation injection and manifest replacement.

findings.title: Diagnostic assertion mutation gate
findings.requiredFollowUp: Keep the critical mutation map and rerun the final diagnostic mutation campaign in REC-145.
findings.resolution: Five focused baseline targets passed. Seven critical diagnostic mutations were killed by their intended assertions; one equivalent control remained equivalent, one invalid assertion API was compilation-invalid, and a separate timeout probe was excluded from effectiveness.

findings.title: Independent diagnostic catalog and retirement oracle
findings.requiredFollowUp: Keep the oracle independent from the descriptor registry and revisit DRIFT-001/DRIFT-002 only with a normative source decision.
findings.resolution: The active enum/catalog inventory passed at 210 entries without a fixed count. All 25 retired numeric values were absent, compatibility-only identifiers were classified without artificial trigger tests, five callable root-cause facts were checked against the authority, and the intentionally wrong MQ3086 explanation was rejected by the independent oracle.

findings.title: Dependent GROUP BY cascade obscured the unresolved rename root
findings.requiredFollowUp: Retain the exact B02 regression and qualified/multi-root neighbors in the evaluator suite.
findings.resolution: Semantic group validation now suppresses MQ3012 only when the current nonaggregate projection is tied to the unresolved GROUP BY root by its terminal expression or structured column suggestion. It reconstructs qualified GROUP BY spans and preserves independent MQ3001 and MQ3012 sibling roots.

findings.title: Bounded nested interpretation did not rebase failure progress or position
findings.requiredFollowUp: Retain the 48-case nested-position matrix and BINARY-045 original-substrate regression.
findings.resolution: InterpretNestedAt now transfers partial child progress to the parent cursor and rebases child-relative ParseException positions while preserving the qualified nested field path. The focused matrix passed 48/48, BINARY-045 passed 8/8, and the Release gate passed 20,775 tests with 0 failures.
